target.statement: QDMN achieves 84.6 J&F on DAVIS 2017 validation set (without synthetic training data)

compute.basis: Training QDMN from scratch requires 2x32GB V100 GPUs for days; even inference on DAVIS 2017 val (30 videos, ~2000 frames) at ~8 FPS on a GPU would take ~4 minutes, but on CPU it would be much slower and likely infeasible; the main cost is training, which cannot be done on a laptop.

blockers: Training requires 2x32GB V100 GPUs (64GB total VRAM) and days of compute
No pretrained model provided in the repository
Inference on CPU is impractically slow for the full validation set
title: Learning Quality-aware Dynamic Memory for Video Object Segmentation
